entities.name: Northern Provinces
entities.description: A collection of farmsteads and small city-states on Terisiare during the Dark Age, later resettled by Kjeldorans.

entities.name: Giva Province
entities.description: A province in the Northern Provinces that housed Jarsyl's farmstead and was frozen over at the start of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: A city-state of the Northern Provinces, birthplace of Tivadar, that fell in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: A mage who stayed in the Conclave of Mages and built a mage tower on his farmstead in Giva Province.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Born on the failing farmstead in Giva Province, where he spent his first years.

entities.name: Tivadar
entities.description: Legendary figure born in Thorn who reformed the Church of Tal to focus on goblins and led a crusade against them.

entities.name: Rasputin Dreamweaver
entities.description: A wizard who aided Tivadar's Crusade.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: A church reformed by Tivadar to focus on the goblin threat rather than magic.

entities.name: Tivadar's Crusade
entities.description: The campaign in which Tivadar and his Knightly Order threw back the Goblin Invasions, ending the Dark Ages.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: A nation that survived the Brothers' War and into the Dark Age.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Hardy people who later re-settled the Northern Provinces.

events.summary: As temperatures kept rising, Argive's larger cities fell apart, leaving farmsteads and villages known as the Northern Provinces.
events.quote: the larger cities of old were unable to sustain themselves and fell apart

events.summary: Jarsyl's farmstead in Giva fails as the land turns swampy, and Jodah is born and spends his first years there before his family abandons it.
events.quote: Jodah was born and spent his first few years on the farm

events.summary: Giva Province is frozen over and depopulated at the start of the Ice Age.
events.quote: was frozen over and depopulated during the Start of the Ice Age

events.summary: Tivadar and his Knightly Order, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, throw back the Goblin Invasions and end the Dark Ages.
events.quote: temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare by throwing back the Goblin Invasions

relations.note: Tivadar reformed the Church to focus on goblins.
relations.quote: Tivadar would eventually reform the Church to focus on the threat of the rampaging goblins
aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver
